attributes.name: prose measure constraint
attributes.definition: Whether body/intro paragraphs in text sections are limited to a width narrower than their container.

values.definition: Paragraphs have a max-width noticeably narrower than the container (e.g. about half or a fixed narrow width).
Paragraphs span the full container width.

attributes.name: text block alignment
attributes.definition: How the constrained text block is positioned within its section.

values.definition: Heading, paragraph and CTA are centered within the section.
Narrow text hugs one side, leaving the other side empty.

attributes.name: text section background band
attributes.definition: Treatment of the background behind text sections.

values.definition: Text section sits on a plain white band spanning the full viewport width.
Any other or unstated background treatment.
